recommendation_data.p1_summary: Offers the most balanced and convenient travel time for the whole group at the meeting time with a 12-minute average, comfortable indoor seating, and stays open until 22:30.
recommendation_data.p2_hours_1: Mon–Sun: 07:00 AM – 07:45 PM • Early closing schedule
recommendation_data.p2_summary: Convenient central location matching tea and coffee preferences, though please note it closes at 19:45, only about 45 minutes after the 19:00 meeting time.
recommendation_data.p3_hours_1: Mon–Sun: 08:00 AM – 11:00 PM • Regular weekly schedule
recommendation_data.p3_summary: Highly rated rooftop garden with 4.6 stars, but the forecast at the meeting time shows an 80% chance of rain for this outdoor space.
recommendation_data.p4_summary: Familiar indoor spot in a central area, though opening hours are not yet verified on the map—please double-check before visiting.
recommendation_data.p5_hours_1: Mon–Sun: 06:30 AM – 06:30 PM • Closed at 19:00 meeting time
recommendation_data.p5_summary: Currently open right now, but closes at 18:30 before the group scheduled meeting time at 19:00. Only shown when viewing all places or places open right now.
recommendation_data.p6_summary: Spacious multi-floor cafe on Dong Khoi street, open late until 23:30 with cozy indoor seating.
recommendation_data.p7_summary: Top-rated dining venue with 4.8 stars and a 14-minute average travel time, ideal for an evening dinner meetup.
recommendation_data.p8_summary: Located inside a shopping mall with convenient underground parking for both motorbikes and cars.
recommendation_data.p9_summary: Located in the iconic 42 Nguyen Hue apartment building with a view of the walking street.
recommendation_data.p10_summary: All-in-one cinema, dining, and entertainment lounge inside Vincom Center, open late until 23:45.

nearby.intro_desc:
When you and a friend both enable this and are within your chosen radius, you'll get a suggestion to create a meetup.

⚠️ We never share your friend's exact location. You only receive a notification saying "You and a friend are nearby."

nearby.disable_body: You won't receive meetup suggestions when friends are nearby.
nearby.cooldown_desc:

Remaining wait time: {{time}}
